panels.title: FuboTV Player Skates In
panels.image: A hockey player skates toward the camera, face lit and in frame, across a rink with FuboTV logos on the boards and digital banners in the stands, cheering crowds in the background, cool ice tones with warm lighting, medium close-up, realistic cinematic style.
panels.motion: The FuboTV hockey player skates forward toward the camera, his face toward the lens, in frame and lit as he speaks.
panels.dialogue: Getting the best deal on hockey isn't a hat trick...

panels.title: Hockey Stop and Sign-Off
panels.motion: The FuboTV hockey player carves a sharp stop, spraying ice mist into the air, his face toward the lens, then pushes off and skates away from the camera. The camera holds on him as he recedes.
